title: Memory Fragments | ECHO//100 Episode 54
description: Kavi discovers his life is a loop, forcing him to confront the architect of his false reality. Mira watches as the boundary between digital code and humanity dissolves forever. Episode 54 of ECHO//100: Byte's Lie. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: Kavi watches as fingertips dissolve into pixelated dust while the red door pulses rhythmically.
scenes.caption: Hand turning into code
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses reaching toward a massive glowing red door in the sky, his right hand disintegrating into floating digital particles.

scenes.text: Mira grips Kavi’s shoulder, her teal holographic coat shimmering against the dark, static sky.
scenes.caption: Mira pulls Kavi back
scenes.image_prompt: Mira, wearing a glowing teal holographic coat, pulling Kavi away from the red door while Byte hovers nearby with a cyan face.

scenes.text: The door surface ripples, projecting a childhood home where a family celebrates without Kavi.
scenes.caption: Empty projections on door
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of the red door surface showing a warm living room scene with people laughing, but the space where Kavi should be is empty.

scenes.text: Kavi searches every frame, yet remains absent from the entirety of this fabricated past.
scenes.caption: Kavi searching for self
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring intensely at the door, his reflection missing from the projected memories playing on the surface.

scenes.text: Byte’s orange antenna flickers while the drone reveals Kavi was merely a witness, not lead.
scenes.caption: Byte confesses the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating silently, his cyan face glowing softly as he looks at Kavi, the red door reflecting in his mechanical eyes.

scenes.text: Null descends suddenly, barricading the red door against Kavi’s desperate, reaching hands.
scenes.caption: Null blocks the door
scenes.image_prompt: The shadowy, glitching figure of Null standing firmly in front of the red door, red eyes glowing with defensive intensity.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes the entire history is a loop, a cage disguised as a life.
scenes.caption: Kavi realizes the lie
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing alone, looking at his hands, realizing his backpack and hoodie are just visual assets of a pre-programmed life.

scenes.text: From behind the red door, a voice whispers a name Kavi has never heard before.
scenes.caption: The mysterious voice calls
scenes.image_prompt: A tight close-up on Kavi’s face, wide-eyed and terrified, as the red door begins to swing open toward a blinding white light.
